title: Launch Week Deals Hit Latest Macs, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Accessories
content:
This week saw the launch of the new Mac mini and Mac Studio, plus the new Beats 360 headphones. You'll find launch discounts on the Macs below, alongside big markdowns on cushion kits for the Beats 360 headphones, AirPods Pro 3, and more.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Mac Mini and Mac Studio



  • What's the deal? Take up to $50 off Mac mini and Mac Studio

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$50 OFF
M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,449.00

$30 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $1,069.00


Amazon recently introduced the first cash discounts on Apple's brand new Mac mini and Mac Studio, with discounts reaching up to $50 off original prices. All of these deals represent the first discounts on the new computers, which just launched this week.

Beats 360



  • What's the deal? Save on Beats 360 cushion kits and more

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

NEW
Beats 360 at Amazon

$40 OFF
Beats 360 Cushion Kits for $9.99


The new Beats 360 headphones were announced this week, and they're now available to order on Amazon and other retailers. They're available in Black, Cloud, plus a bundle where you can style the headphones however you'd like thanks to interchangeable ear cushions and headbands.

Alongside the launch, Beats announced that its Cushion Kits compatible with the Beats 360 are available for just $9.99 for the next month, down from $49.99. Amazon has both the Performance Knit and UltraPlush options in all colors at this price.

Apple Watch Ultra 4



  • What's the deal? Take $19 off Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$19 OFF
Apple Watch Ultra 4 for $779.99


The new Apple Watch Ultra 4 just launched last week, and Amazon is offering the first cash discounts on select models for the first time since their launch. You can get the Apple Watch Ultra 4 for $779.99, down from $799.00.

iPad Air



  • What's the deal? Take $100 off M4 iPad Air

Amazon this week has multiple discounts on the M4 iPad Air, providing up to $149 off these 2026 models. These remain the best prices we've seen in the wake of Apple's summer price hikes, and many deals are being matched at Best Buy.

AirPods Pro 3



  • What's the deal? Take $50 off AirPods Pro 3

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$50 OFF
AirPods Pro 3 for $199.00


Amazon has the AirPods Pro 3 available for $199.00 this week, down from $249.00. We haven't tracked an all-time low price on this model since Prime Day over the summer, but this is still a solid $50 markdown.
